# neo-pi - Raspberry Pi 4 / 400 and Raspberry Pi 3
arm_64bit=1
kernel_address=0x80000
initial_turbo=0

# HDMI always on (even if the TV is switched on later), no border, audio
hdmi_force_hotplug=1
disable_overscan=1
hdmi_drive=2
framebuffer_ignore_alpha=1

# 1080p 60 Hz. No picture? Put a # in front of both lines.
# For 720p, change hdmi_mode=16 to hdmi_mode=4.
hdmi_group=1
hdmi_mode=16

# Sharp pixels from the hardware scaler; name in the TV's source list
scaling_kernel=8
cec_osd_name=NEO-PI

# Fast start-up, fixed GPU clock
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
force_eeprom_read=0
core_freq_fixed=1

# Overclock: remove the # in front of arm_freq (heatsink needed)
[pi3]
kernel=kernel8.img
#arm_freq=1300

[pi3+]
kernel=kernel8.img
#arm_freq=1500

[pi4]
armstub=armstub8-rpi4.bin
kernel=kernel8-rpi4.img
max_framebuffers=2
#arm_freq=1900

[all]
